page: Microsoft Azure D2ds_v4 is a general-purpose virtual machine deployed on Microsoft Hyper-V. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon Platinum 8272CL processor operating at 2.6 GHz. The instance configuration allocates 2 vCPUs derived from a single physical core with hyper-threading enabled. Compute resources are coupled with 8.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per core) and an included 81 GB local SSD temporary disk. No graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned with this instance.

Benchmark results highlight solid single-threaded performance alongside constrained multi-threaded capacity. The system achieves average tier results in single-core evaluations, including a Geekbench single-core score of 1186.0 and stress-ng single-core performance of 1564.29, supported by instruction extensions like AVX-512 and VNNI. Single-threaded gzip compression (23.98 GB/sec) and bzip3 decompression (9.28 GB/sec) also settle within the middle 50% percentile.

Conversely, multi-core metrics and overall throughput place in the lower performance brackets due to the physical limit of one dual-threaded core. The Geekbench multi-core score (1413.0), PassMark CPU score (2212.97), and stress-ng multi-core metric (1598.88) consistently rank in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show 11.82 GB/sec read and 9.21 GB/sec write for large uncached blocks, and operational workloads like Redis SET operations reach 1.8 million operations per second, representing the bottom tier of cloud server benchmarks.

Given its balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio and bundled high-speed local temporary SSD storage, the D2ds_v4 offers an entry-level compute footprint. It fits low-concurrency workloads such as development or test environments, lightweight web hosting, microservices, small background workers, and simple caching layers that do not demand high multi-threaded compute or extensive memory throughput.
description: Microsoft Azure D2ds_v4 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8272CL processor at 2.6 GHz, running under Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is provisioned with 2 vCPUs across 1 physical core, 8.0 GB of RAM, and an integrated 81 GB local SSD, without GPU acceleration. Benchmark profiles indicate capable single-threaded execution, ranking in the middle tier for single-core tasks like gzip compression and Geekbench single-core tests. However, overall multi-core processing, memory throughput, and static web serving rank in the bottom 10% relative to broader cloud hardware benchmarks due to the single-core hardware ceiling. The D2ds_v4 offers an efficient balance of compute, RAM, and fast local temporary storage for small-scale web servers, lightweight microservices, and development environments.
